ios.desc:
You don't need another habit tracker. You need the right habits.

ILLLL tracks the 6 daily habits with the strongest scientific evidence for extending your lifespan and improving your healthspan. No fluff. No premium tier. No data harvesting. Just the habits that matter.

THE 6 HABITS

BREATHING
5 minutes of structured breathing drops cortisol, raises HRV, and outperforms meditation for anxiety reduction. Stanford research, 2023.

MORNING LIGHT
10-30 minutes of sunlight sets your circadian clock, boosts serotonin, and is as effective as antidepressants for mood. JAMA Psychiatry, 2016.

HEALTHY FOOD
A balanced plate cuts depression risk 33% and cardiovascular disease 30%. The SMILES trial proved diet changes alone can reverse depression.

SLEEP
Your brain clears toxic waste during deep sleep. Less than 7 hours raises mortality 13%. One bad night cuts emotional regulation by 60%.

EXERCISE
The #1 intervention for longevity. 11 minutes of daily walking cuts premature death risk 23%. More effective than SSRIs for depression. BMJ, 2024.

GRATITUDE
Writing 3 specific things daily rewires your prefrontal cortex. 10-25% improvement in well-being. Measurable neural changes that last months.

WHY ILLLL

- Completely free. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. Ever.
- Your data never leaves your device. Zero analytics. Zero tracking.
- No account required. Open the app and start.
- Every habit backed by peer-reviewed research with full articles to read.
- Track streaks, view progress charts, and see your annual heatmap.
- Add your own custom habits alongside the core six.
- Available in 20+ languages.
- Works offline. No internet required.
- Beautiful dark and light modes.

The name says it all: I'll Live Longer. Download it. Build the habits. Live longer.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an app to live longer (free, open source, no tracking)

quotes.text:
I made it for me, nothing fancy, but feel free to use it as well.

It's free, no account needed (no server, all data stays on your phone), no tracking, open sourced (https://github.com/bdav24/illll).

It's a tracker for 6 longevity habits backed by research:

1. Sleep — brain clears toxic waste during deep sleep, <7h raises mortality 13%

2. Exercise — 11 min/day of walking cuts premature death risk 23% (Br J Sports Med, 2023)

3. Healthy eating — cuts depression risk 33% (SMILES trial), cardiovascular disease 30% (NEJM, 2018)

4. Structured breathing — 5 min/day, lowers cortisol, raises HRV (Stanford, 2023)

5. Morning sunlight — 10-30 min, sets circadian clock, boosts serotonin (JAMA Psychiatry, 2016)

6. Gratitude — writing 3 things daily, measurable neural changes lasting months

But you can also set custom goals and add your own habits.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/illll-live-longer/id6760903742

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.devanco.illll.app

Any feedback is welcome!
